scope: Constructed a noncanonical dominant algebraic lift of the existing Kuznetsov residual morphism rho from a nonempty open of the17-dimensional O-marked Jacobian Abel moduli to nonzero Poisson cubic-threefold pairs, compatible with forgetting Poisson. A17-dimensional scheme atlas can be shrunk so its composite is etale; no representability, finite-morphism or birational claim for the stack map. Constructed the actual residual map on all framed Abel Artin deformations at every smooth commutative cubic, and a noncanonical formal Poisson-pair isomorphism over this actual Ku base. Formal residual fiber is the completed affine Plucker cone of Gr(2,5), dimension7 and tangent dimension10. Proved failure of naive inverse symmetrization of a quantum central cubic, including on a projective chart. Intrinsic quantization-compatible algebraic dequantization remains unproved.

review.definition: All exact O-preserving equivalences are retained. The full fpqc-stackified framed Artin completion at a smooth cubic is now equivalent to all flat Abelian deformations; nonnoetherian covers are handled in big QGr using the original Artin coefficient map. This does not assert general category 2-descent or a finite-type atlas for the full moduli problem. The Jacobian full substack has a separately constructed finite-type etale atlas.
review.relative_veronese: Complete proof checked, including universal polynomial embedding, Cech intersection from P-flatness, nonreduced-base conic lifting, mu2 Isom torsor, grading-scalar sheaf quotient, and H1 versus H2 descent. An independent reading found no substantive error; section reconstruction on the conic was made explicit.
review.pointed_hom: Original C1-C4 and finite-central compact versions retained. The general finite-Koszul version supplies proper compact Serre duality and reconstructs all exact O-preserving Abelian equivalences over every commutative C-algebra, using full-integer even Gabriel sections and the relative Veronese lift. Eq_O=Isom_gr/Gm is an fpqc sheaf statement, not a quotient of global point sets.
review.formal_cubic: DDL all-Artin comparison and O-marking classical 1-groupoid convention retained. Lowen Thms3.14/3.26, Yekutieli Cors7.5/11.2, and objectwise unique lifts independently checked against original sources. The main full-Abel envelope theorem uses constructed-family surjectivity directly, not prior periodicity or the stronger central-pair injectivity theorem.
review.envelope_reduction: All-degree envelope flatness is now proved for every flat Abelian Artin deformation of a smooth complex cubic threefold. Consequently the retained normal-regular cubic kernel and relative Koszul-AS5 proofs apply. This is relative AS over possibly singular Artin bases, not absolute global dimension five.
review.degree_three_obstruction: B3=R^34 direct_sum R/I and I=Fitt_34(B3) retained. Complete nilpotent sorting proof establishes degree-three flatness iff all-degree flatness for nonperiodic quadratic Z-algebras with polynomial special fibre. Independently reviewed. General Koszul deformation principle is established literature, PP Ch6 Thm7.3, not claimed new.
review.rigid_ambient_application: The retained PBW, AS5, CY and Aut_gr(B_*)(C)=C* inputs are explicit. Cartier characteristic-zero smoothness upgrades the finite-type automorphism group scheme to Gm. Quadratic envelope and leading gamma coefficient then prove arbitrary-coefficient graded isomorphism iff f=g. Compact relative Hom and fixed-family fpqc Hom descent give a monomorphism A4→M^O on finite-type complex tests. No open immersion, atlas or component assertion.
review.retained_results: Existing 41/37 and17/13 constructions, gcd periodicity, all-Artin envelope, square-zero obstruction and formal-ring proofs retained. New universal coefficient, finite central, Serre and full-family relative comparison proofs were reviewed. The complete older PBW/CY/rigid calculation proofs were not newly reconstructed, and unchanged calculations were not rerun.
review.novelty: Fixed-cubic Poisson Grassmannian, deformation quantization inputs and relative transcendence-basis arguments are established results/methods. The current concrete additional work is the all-Abel residual construction, compatible formal product, application to the existing17-dimensional moduli morphism, and explicit naive-center obstruction. These statements have written proofs and internal independent readings. Exhaustive priority checking, full audit of retained inputs and external human review remain unfinished.
review.square_zero_obstruction: Complete proof independently reviewed: Schur residual Theta=delta(q_(i+1)-q_i)=F lambda; delta^2=0 and injectivity on constant three-cochains force lambda=0. Valid for any nonzero cubic, no smoothness, with dim V>=4; written in five-variable case. General Artin I subset m^2 follows by Fitting base change. Nonlinear Jacobi corrections prevent naive higher-order induction.
review.homogeneous_quantization: CFT arXiv:math/0012228v3 §3, Thm3.1, Prop3.3 and Cor5.2(iv) checked. Finite nilpotent substitution, graph-degree preservation, alpha=Pi/2 normalization, quadraticity via split-kernel Nakayama, and central cubic regularity supplied explicitly. Full graded Hochschild/Poisson gauge classification is not assumed.

Yekutieli makes Ass represented by the same T. The actual constructed map has injective 20-dimensional tangent map, hence induces an invertible continuous endomorphism of T. review.universal_coefficients: Direct Gabriel localization for arbitrary commutative S; tails torsion verified localizing using finite degree-one generation. Flat-object Ext1 reduction, finite-length induction and fp-source filtered-colimit Hom prove universal saturation. review.coefficient_descent: Internal faithfully flat descent checked via Lazard, purity/conservativity and coaction equalizer. Exact equivalences extend uniquely by adjoint mates. Hom groupoids retain natural isomorphisms; only O-marked trivial-2-inertia models permit the stated descent after passing to isomorphism classes. Full category 2-descent is not claimed.
review.canonical_relative_formal: Canonical coefficient families and all O-marked Abel deformations remain equivalent. The new full stack comparison constructs a global canonical model for every stackified framed Artin object by scalar cocycle correction and ordinary section-algebra descent.
review.universal_line_cohomology: Finite flat Ore Cech complexes commute arbitrary scalar tensor. Small-extension five-lemma proves finite free cohomology: H0 for n>=0, none for n=-1, H3 of rank h(-n-2) for n<=-2. Locally projective line objects give perfect RHom with arbitrary derived base change. This is a proof, not a numerical experiment.
review.finite_central_model: Rains Thm2.13 hypotheses checked. Reduced finite-type constant-rank commutator kernels lift central symbols; homogeneous lifts give finite graded central C. Arbitrary base change uses C_S as a central action, without claiming its injectivity or full-center base-change equality. review.central_universal_sections: Noetherian coefficients: regular central u^ell,v^ell give H0/H1 local-cohomology vanishing. Arbitrary coefficients: write S as filtered colimit of finite-type P-subalgebras, use fp standard objects, arbitrary coefficient Gabriel equivalence and free-action adjunction. All-shift saturation is universal. Even reconstruction and functor determination retain their noetherian finite-presentation argument.
review.intrinsic_perfect_open: Coherent Ext localizes to all central affine charts via twist resolutions, finite Cech and filtered colimits; fg syzygy plus Baer gives chart gldim from geometric-generic tails regularity. RSV finite-central PI smoothness and direct splitting-denominator spread yield relative perfect diagonals on a nonempty base open. Diagonal resolutions imply finite base-Tor equals locally Perf after arbitrary noetherian base change. review.relative_rhom: For the finite-central family, local A-perfect Hom is ambient O_Z-perfect after the projective embedding. Stacks0B91 supplies perfect global RHom and arbitrary derived coefficient base change. This underlies the new relative Serre theorem. Nonflat central Proj is allowed; ordinary O_Y-derived pullback is not substituted.
review.universal_degree_two_center: For the concrete B_* family, the rank12 commutator map is injective at every closed coefficient point by the retained low-center lemmas. Jacobsonness makes the rank open all of Spec P; split injectivity survives every commutative coefficient base change, including nonnoetherian rings. Full-center base change is not asserted.
review.field_bimodule_duality: Yekutieli1992 Prop5.2, direct balanced check via torsion of injectives, and bimodule uniqueness identify RHom_T(A,R_T) with R_A. Exact Veronese plus graded injective localization gives projective ambient dual E_-2[3] as bimodule, with shift [-1]. RRZ Nakayama/AS-index relation and central cubic quotient give untwisted R_A=A(-2)[4] under retained B_* inputs.
review.relative_serre: Construct D_P=RHom_OZ(j_*A,omega[N]) over regular P=C[a,b,c,d]. Finite ambient perfect resolutions and A P-flatness give underlying ambient base change compatible with both actions. Stacks00MI gives D=W[3] with W P-flat. Taking H^-3 after coefficient base change gives strict bimodule W⊗S, without an enveloping-algebra flatness assumption. Tensor-Hom and projective Groth trace give natural Serre (-2)[3] with arbitrary noetherian base change. No generic regularity needed.
review.compact_serre_normalization: BDG Defs3.1/3.13 and Thm3.14 checked. Exact equivalences extend to standard unbounded dg enhancements, preserve coproducts/K-injectives and compact objects. All line objects are locally projective and compact. Choice differences are scalar on the line sequence by faithful adjacent Hom; no claim that all transformations on the entire perfect category are scalar.
review.full_stackified_hom: Fixed canonical families have arbitrary fpqc Hom descent, including non-finite-type covers; pointed trivial 2-inertia upgrades representatives to coherent actual transitions. This input is now also used to construct global objects in the framed Artin completion at a smooth cubic. General effective descent of arbitrary category families is not asserted.
review.flat_cover_reconstruction: DDL Thm4.5 applied to original coherent R→C and the C-linear category QCoh(X_{S/mS}); no coherent/noetherian S assumption. Flatness of tails over R follows via injective/coflat criterion and exact Gabriel quotient. R-flat finite m-filtration proves S-free section Hom; representable images then give S-flat line objects. Universal Hom/Ext1 uses finite mS-filtration, and all-q Ext reduction + finite affine Cech gives finite presentation. Companions and primary hypotheses independently reviewed.
review.unipotent_amitsur_descent: Actual framed overlaps yield defects in 1+m S^(tensor3), not full Gm. Finite log/exp identifies the cosimplicial group with m tensor S^(tensor•); Stacks023M exactness kills the defects. E0 retains its original marking. Finite-projective Hom and composition descend by023N/058S; DDL plus retained cubic envelope/universal admissibility then gives global model. review.framed_automorphisms: Direct section derivation proof: quadratic commutativity forces adjacent derivations to differ by scalars; vertex scalars normalized at0 reduce to one M; D_M(F) in CF, Euler subtraction and regular quadratic gradient Koszul syzygies force M scalar. review.full_discrete_formal_ring: All framed automorphism classes vanish, so the full stackified framed Artin groupoid is equivalent to its discrete pi0, represented noncanonically by the retained20-variable/five-Pfaffian ring of dimension17. Unframed Aut(X), unrestricted2-groupoids, algebraization and atlas claims excluded. Explicit nonliftable epsilon bivector and non-complete-intersection consequence proved, without numerical testing.
review.general_relative_torsion: Finite Koszul diagonal yields bounded exact-functor models for RΓ_B, including nonnoetherian coefficients and unbounded complexes. Each B/B_>=n is finite coefficient-projective. Torsion acyclicity, localizing generation, derived Gabriel quotient, and Rω preserving coproducts are proved. review.general_local_duality: Finite coefficient-projective tensor-Hom CY duality gives RΓ_B(B)=B∨(5)[-5]. Central quotient Rees coinduction gives RΓ_A(A)=A∨(2)[-4]. Mixed B-A actions are promoted to true A-bimodule actions only after single-degree concentration, using the heart and the surjection B→A. Derived restriction is not assumed fully faithful. The standard triangle and its maps, not only ranks, commute arbitrary base change.
review.general_dg_serre: Left-A-action injective resolution supplies strict graded dg A→Q; dg Yoneda identifies restriction with Rω, so Q⊗^L_AQ=Q. Dualizing Γ→A→Q and applying both-sided Q-localization kills torsion A∨ and yields Q∨=Q(-2)[3] as a genuine Q-bimodule, retaining higher actions. Rains denominators are units. Closed-fiber PBW plus reduced constant-rank matrices and projective splittings give universally projective B,A and regular central w. The rank12 commutator map is universally split injective, yielding quadratic center Sym²U. Degree-one generation gives even Veronese Gabriel equivalence and fully faithful full-integer section right adjoint without noetherianity. Keeler corrected v5 gives strong noetherianity of the elliptic THCR and filtered algebras; six-step dimension shift and cdΓ_B<=5 give ordinary/even ample sequences over noetherian coefficients.

Coherent iteration of Serre^-1[3]=(2) identifies the even orbit algebra; choice differences are degree scalars by faithful adjacent Hom. Full-integer Gabriel sections determine actual equivalences, the μ2 Isom lift supplies local degree-one isomorphisms, and marked2-autos vanish. Fixed canonical family fpqc Hom descent is retained. Independent readings found no concrete gap; not external peer review.
review.general17_finite_isom: With A1=A1prime=S5 and standard cubic Hilbert ranks, I2⊂V² has rank10 and I3⊂V³ rank91. Quadratic+cubic presentation identifies Eq_O with the closed finitely presented subscheme of PGL5 preserving both relation subbundles, valid for nonreduced S. Source O(1) descent is not claimed; the commutative target ambient splits by omega(2D). Full-M algebraicity/componenthood and generic-fiber birationality remain open.
review.jacobian_etale_atlas: The dominant equal-dimensional PGL5×T_B→Q113 map is generically etale in characteristic zero. Flat base change of the etale locus and universal group translation give E=G×T_B^e as open subschemes, and Y=a(E) is invariant open. T_B^e→[Y/G] is an actual etale surjective atlas. Quotient algebraicity/DM criteria use checked Stacks results; no extra finite-stabilizer assumption or Pym analytic/formal comparison is needed for this construction.
review.jacobian_universal_centers: On every P_B-algebra S, Z(B_S)_1=Su+Sv and Z(B_S)_3=S G + Sym^3(Su+Sv). Low-degree THCR center vanishing and active leading symbols compute closed fibers. PBW splits the candidate centers; the induced finite-projective commutator map is fiberwise injective and locally split, proving arbitrary nonflat base change. On Y use GL5×T_B^e as a further fpqc cover; no global GL lift of the universal PGL element is presumed.
review.jacobian_affine_four: J=P_Y(E) minus P_Y(W), with ranks(E,W,L)=(5,4,1), represents splittings of E→L and is a torsor under Hom(L,W). Central weights3 cancel on Hom and projective lines, so the bundle and J descend to PGL. Affine fpqc descent proves C_J→B_J is scheme-representable, affine, smooth, surjective of relative dimension4. Pullback atlas is exactly T_B^e×A4; global zero/splitting is not chosen.
review.jacobian_all_abel_full_substack: The G-equivariant locally closed embedding J→Gr(10,V^2)×Gr(91,V^3) recovers the central cubic line as I3/K3, including nonreduced bases. Scalar structure transport is canonically marked-isomorphic to the identity by m_d tensor b→lambda^d m_d b, coherently under products. All-Hom comparison on simultaneous fpqc slice covers descends, giving C_J→M^O fully faithful for all coefficient rings. Its essential image is the full substack of families locally modeled on the atlas, not a fiberwise geometric-point condition.
review.jacobian_scope: C_J and B_J are smooth finite-type DM stacks of dimensions17 and13 with affine finite-presentation unramified diagonals. Geometric stabilizers are finite, but triviality, finite diagonal, proper inertia, separatedness and global coarse moduli are not proved. The inclusion into full M is not asserted representable/open/locally closed/formally complete. B_J uses projectively graded ambient isomorphisms, not all O-marked ambient Abelian equivalences.
review.finite_center_global_diagonal: For perfect k, finite-type separated Y and coherent O_Y-algebra A, assume Dbcoh(A)=Perf(A) on both sides. ELS4.15 gives G; duality gives Gdual on opposite. ELS4.18(b) makes Gdual box G a classical generator for Dbcoh(Aop box A). The coherent diagonal delta_*A is in its thick closure. Local finite-projective tensor-Hom and finite Cech/Kunneth identify End with Eop tensor E and Hom into diagonal with diagonal E, respecting actions/Koszul signs. Hence global dg smoothness; proper Y gives properness. No O_Y-flatness assumption or unproved local-to-global shortcut.
review.dg_generic_spreading: R-perfect E over noetherian domain R has R-perfect enveloping D. TV2.10/ToenF4 descend the perfect generic diagonal to P perfect over a localization of D; compactness of source P descends its isomorphism into E without assuming E D-perfect. The cone is coefficient-perfect and generically zero, hence vanishes after one more localization. Relative smooth properness and arbitrary derived base change follow; no hfp assumption. Any field-extension descent proved by finite generated scalar descent, a closed point finite extension and a linear restriction/retract.
review.finite_order_field_scope: CSBG center-lifting/global-open are explicitly over an arbitrary algebraically closed characteristic-zero field. The proof uses total chart U=D_u[three cubic coefficients], Rains2.13, reduced Jacobson constant-rank matrices and RSV2.1. It does not use very-general points or uncountability. Apply independently to B and Bop; inverse boundary translation preserves finite order.
review.torsion_base_relative_smooth: For integral affine Z in T0 with finite-order geometric generic boundary, put F=C(Z)(eleven mixed), K=F(four cubic). Choose Fbar inside Kbar. Fixed ambient regularity over Fbar applies because cubic coefficients remain algebraically independent. Left/right qgr global dimension3 gives Dbcoh=Perf via twist generation, and a finite-central projective model exists at the geometric generic point. Global diagonal lemma, field descent and generic spreading give a nonempty principal open in Z times A15 with arbitrary-base relative smooth properness. Uniform choice of center over the whole base is not needed. Fixed ambient A4 is proved separately, not by assuming every A4 fiber meets an A15 open.
review.torsion_curves_density: T0 is an affine open of the Hesse elliptic surface: p=2-b,q=-(2+b),r=-6a,p-q=4 and mu=(p^3+q^3+r^3)/(pqr). WWY2.13 identifies sigma with translation by [p:q:r]. Infinite torsion on each smooth Hesse fiber proves density in T0. E[n] is finite etale over the mu-line, via relative differential n and proper quasi-finiteness; connected components of E[n] intersect T0 are smooth integral affine curves. Every open W in atlas meets one such Z times A15. Intersecting two nonempty opens in that integral16 base proves the dense16-family theorem. No embedded-substack or full17 open claim.
review.formal_quantization_route: Actual18-parameter algebraic h-bridge proved over one finite-denominator base, with d(0)=256. Mori-Smith applies at every h including0. Constant closed-fiber Hilbert rank over the reduced base gives projective pieces on the same base, and potential self-duality gives true relative CY5. The h-notzero chart is a rational coordinate change to the original17-parameter family. Special F is generically smooth by an explicit witness; its GL5 orbit plus17 coefficient differential has rank35 by the retained certificate. The formerly proposed general FS implication is false; explicit counterexamples are retained in notes1.8.2 and no proof relies on it.
review.relative_kuznetsov: Finite dg mutations give the left projector, both adjoints, finite compact generator and enriched relative Serre autoequivalence with inverse and arbitrary derived base change. The residual category descends along every O-marked Abel equivalence even without global O(1). Euler chi(G2,G2)=-9 and chi(G,G)=-2925 guarantee every field fiber is nonzero. Proper relative Kronecker5 gluing proves full tails smooth iff residual smooth.
review.ku_formal_recognition: Kuznetsov HH table has only HH0=k, HH2=k10. JLLZ identifies the actual geometric Kodaira-Spencer map. Lurie tame1-proximate comparison is(-1)-truncated, hence pi0-injective. The controlling Lie cohomology is in odd degrees-1,1 only, so transferred minimal L-infinity operations vanish by parity. The geometric formal10-disk fills the hull via the formal inverse theorem, proving recognition on ordinary local Artin bases. pi1=0; scalar pi2 is retained. Universal algebraic comparison gives arbitrary k/C.
review.ku_effective_serre_embedding: Compatible kernels are effectivized as coefficient-perfect complexes using Bhatt Lem4.2; derived-complete End_R(P) effectivizes both actions. No Gamma-perfect effectivity is presumed. Smoothness of geometric target implies right-target perfectness. Derived Nakayama on the coefficient-perfect cone of E→End_D(P) gives full faithfulness. Enriched trace/Yoneda gives a coherent Serre comparison, an isomorphism by special-fiber Nakayama. Generic Serre and inverse-Serre stability use E and S_E^-1 E, without assuming every generic object lifts.
review.ku_serre_thick_generation: Stevenson Thm6.13 classifies all thick subcategories of an affine locally-hypersurface singularity category; isolated cone singularity gives ungraded simplicity. Explicit gradedization G and forgetting F give GF(P)=direct_sum P(a), and F is conservative by homogeneous contracting homotopies. Finite-rank matrix factorizations are compact; Neeman Lem2.2 turns localizing generation into thick generation. Orlov MF/window equivalence and rotation=S[-1] give Serre-stable thick simplicity for smooth cubic threefold Ku. Together with nonzero Euler this makes the effective generic embedding an equivalence.
review.ku_spreading_descent: Field descent first gives smoothness at the17-dimensional function field. Perfect equivalence and inverse kernels, unit and counit descend along filtered coefficient colimits (TV2.10). A closed point of a finitely generated subalgebra gives a finite extension, separable in characteristic0; normalization and localization give a finite-etale cover. Relative kernels and inverse identities spread on an open. BMMS categorical Torelli, extended to k/C by finite-presentation spreading, identifies coarse maps on reduced overlaps; separatedness and etale descent give the actual morphism on C_J. No algebraicity of a general stack of dg categories is assumed.
review.ku_dominance: The exact35-minor of the GL5-plus-coefficient differential is nonzero modulo1000003, so the classical17-parameter family dominates cubic moduli. The closure of the residual image contains the generic and hence special points of the h-adic geometric cubic deformation. It therefore contains the dominant classical family. Restriction to the nonempty automorphism-free open and characteristic-zero generic smoothness yield a smooth surjection of relative dimension7.
review.counterexamples: Notes1.8.2 contains checked counterexamples to general compact-Gamma formal effectivity, generator-locus openness even in smooth proper P1, and coefficient-perfect special-smooth→generic-smooth (even with all Artin cuts geometric smooth proper). The last example has cohomological coefficient torsion and does not disprove separately cohomology-flat statements. The current proof uses coefficient-Perf effectivity, enriched Serre and cubic-specific thick generation instead.
review.full_abel_artin_residual: Existing thm:abel-cubic-flat-envelope(iii) supplies A_R=B_R/(w_R) for every full framed Abel Artin deformation. Finite universal Koszul resolution plus B/A derived torsion comparison, requiring inputs(1),(2),(4) but no CY orientation, gives the five-line compact generator via -tensor_B^L A and conservative restriction. Universal line Hom gives coefficient-perfect End(G) and arbitrary derived base change. Unique O_X(1) lift and scalar cancellation give invariance under framed O-marked equivalences. Ind Perf(E_R) with special Morita framing is an actual CatDef_c object; no source-smoothness premise is used. Commutative families map to their own Ku.
review.relative_poisson_cone: Target ambient Brauer-Severi P4 bundle splits because omega_B/V(2D) restricts to O(1). Relative conormal/Euler computations give ranks10/15 and arbitrary base change. Mayanskiy Schouten-Plucker formula plus fiberwise independence of five partial derivatives gives a locally split injection; therefore scheme ideals, not only point sets, agree. Nonzero cone has A6 times Gm big cell and is relatively smooth of dimension7. Poisson scale is retained.
review.ku_compatible_formal_poisson: Choose existing quantization comparison Q of R_X=A0[[s1,...,s10]], A0=C[[a_ij]]/Pfaff4. Actual residual r gives rQ=f(s,a), f(s,0)=s. Theta=(f,a) is an A0-linear formal automorphism for the maximal-ideal topology even though A0 is singular. Theta Q^{-1} is over the actual Ku base, identity on commutative locus. Formal fiber is completed cone dimension7/tangent10. No algebraization/convergence or equality of uncorrected Q^{-1} with this lift is asserted.
review.algebraic_poisson_lift: For K=C(V), L=C(C_J), choose separating relative transcendence basis t1,...,t7, remove invariant poles and t7=0, and map into a01-notzero Plucker chart. This gives an actual dominant stack morphism over rho, natural under all O-marked equivalences once choices fixed, with finite separable function-field extension. A dominant17-dimensional etale atlas is generically etale over the target; restricting its etale locus and image gives the stated atlas. No proof of degree1 or intrinsic semi-classical meaning.
review.symmetrization_obstruction: Retained Fermat central formula gives w=f-h^2 T/9+u^3+v^3. Generic sym is invertible by its h=0 specialization, with inverse H=f-2h^2 xyz/3+u^3+v^3. Direct derivation yields {x,H}=-2h^3 x(z^3-y^3)/3. Coefficient comparison excludes ideal(H). On u-notzero chart, Hbar is monic cubic in v/u whereas the nonzero bracket has degree0 in v/u, excluding the projective Poisson-subvariety claim as well. Generic H is smooth by Fermat specialization. This is a written algebraic proof, not a new numerical test, and does not disprove corrected dequantization.
